text:
You need a WordPress developer who has real Salient/WPBakery experience and can customize the theme for a long-term role during your 3–4 pm EST window.

I’m Tobias Reyne, and I bring 7 years of full-stack development experience with a focus on building polished, fast, maintainable web interfaces. My main stack includes JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS. While my background is broader than WordPress alone, I’m very comfortable working on front-end customization, component-level implementation, and performance-minded builds.

One project that reflects the kind of work I do is the Home goods storefront rebuild for Juniper & Ash Home. I replaced a slow theme-based shop with a headless storefront and CMS the marketing team edits themselves. That change brought the largest contentful paint from 4.1s to 1.3s and increased organic traffic by 38% in 3 months. The work required careful UI implementation, clean content workflows, and attention to speed and maintainability—qualities that carry over well when customizing a premium theme like Salient.

If your Salient site needs layout adjustments, template refinements, responsive fixes, or more tailored front-end behavior, I can help structure the work cleanly and keep it easy to maintain. I’m used to collaborating closely and can align with a consistent schedule if your preferred overlap with EST hours is important for the project.

I should be direct: I have not worked with Salient specifically, so I don’t want to misrepresent that. If you’re open to someone who is strong in front-end development and theme customization-adjacent work, I’d be glad to discuss the scope and see whether my experience is a fit.

What specific Salient pages or sections do you want customized first?
